skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-meta-poas-bidding
skill.description: Set up profit-based bidding in Meta Ads for a Cloudflare storefront using Product Metrics and the Meta Conversions API. Verify profit event delivery and choose a starting target. The guide also covers revenue-based bidding.
skill.summary: Guide Meta Ads to bid on estimated order profit instead of revenue.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown labels, routine setup checks, or vendor links; the unpinned installer remains a supply chain risk. The workflow also asks assistants to handle a Meta token and tells users to approve every requested Cloudflare permission. Meta setup can enable more event types and customer data sharing than the profit goal alone requires.

remediation.issue: The assistant is told to obtain and pass the Meta Conversions API token.
remediation.suggestion: Require token entry in the verified Product Metrics app. Remove instructions to request the token in chat or pass it to a command.

remediation.issue: The installer can resolve an unpinned package and a mutable repository source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and reviewed source commit. Document integrity checks and keep installation a separate user decision.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting tells users to approve every permission.
remediation.suggestion: List the minimum Cloudflare scopes and explain each one. Stop if the consent screen requests undocumented access or shows the wrong account or zone.

remediation.issue: The setup enables Meta delivery without a separate review of the event and customer data scope.
remediation.suggestion: Show which fields and events will go to the selected Meta pixel before enabling delivery. Limit the event scope where supported.

content.user_title: Set Up Profit Bidding in Meta Ads with Cloudflare
content.value_statement: A Meta campaign can meet its revenue target and still lose money after product costs and fees. Use Product Metrics and Cloudflare Tracking to set up bidding based on estimated order profit.
actual_capabilities: Check Cloudflare and Meta setup progress through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP, or guide the user through the web app.
Guide setup of a Cloudflare tracking gateway, a Meta destination, and consent settings.
Explain how to estimate product costs and include shipping, payment fees, and other costs in the margin.
Guide a test order, verify profit event delivery, and explain how to clear the test event code.
Show the user how to create the Meta profit conversion and choose a starting target for profit or revenue bidding.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and access to the relevant Product Metrics workspace and Meta pixel.
Website orders have no item costs. Estimated profit depends on a fallback cost percentage and any additional costs you configure.
The user approves Cloudflare access, creates the Meta custom conversion, and selects the ad set conversion event.
Past orders are not imported, and later refunds or cancellations do not revise Meta events already sent.

use_cases.title: Check storefront readiness
use_cases.description: Identify which permissions, connections, consent settings, and cost inputs are needed before testing profit events.

use_cases.title: Pilot profit bidding
use_cases.description: Plan a switch from the revenue event to a profit conversion for one Meta sales campaign.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing profit events
use_cases.description: Trace a test purchase from Cloudflare to Meta and check for incomplete costs, missing consent, or an active test code.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: learn what profit bidding needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how profit bidding differs from revenue bidding for my Cloudflare storefront. List what I need before connecting Product Metrics and Meta.

prompt_templates.title: Review connection status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my selected Product Metrics property without changing settings. Tell me which Cloudflare and Meta steps are complete and what I must do next.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a missing profit event
prompt_templates.prompt: My test purchase reached Meta, but the profit event is missing. Help me check cost coverage, consent, and test mode. Do not ask for credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a one-campaign pilot
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: move from revenue to profit bidding.
prompt_templates.prompt: My campaign currently earns 1.5 in estimated order profit per unit of ad spend. Suggest a starting profit target, validation checks, and the Meta settings I must change myself.

output_examples.input: Meta received the purchase, but the profit event is missing.
output: Check that your product cost fallback and additional costs are active.
Place another test order with marketing and analytics consent, then look for the profit event in Meta.
Clear the test event code once you confirm delivery.

output_examples.input: My campaign earns 1.5 in estimated order profit per unit of ad spend.
output: Consider 150% as a starting target for the profit event. Do not reuse your revenue target.
Start with one campaign. Select the profit conversion yourself, then review results after a few weeks.

best_practices: Enter the Meta Conversions API token only in the verified Product Metrics app.
Review Cloudflare permissions, Meta event sharing, and shopper consent settings before enabling delivery.
Verify a consented test order with complete costs, then clear the test code before launching a pilot.
anti_patterns: Keep the revenue target unchanged after switching to the profit event.
Treat the fallback cost percentage as an exact item cost.
Share the Meta access token in chat or include it in a command or summary.

faq.question: What is profit on ad spend?
faq.answer: It divides estimated order profit before ad spend by ad spend. A target of 100% means the estimated profit covers the ad spend.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. This workflow uses Cloudflare Tracking on a proxied domain and reads purchases from the order confirmation page.

faq.question: How does Product Metrics calculate profit?
faq.answer: It subtracts estimated product costs and configured costs from revenue before tax. Orders with incomplete costs are sent with revenue only.

faq.question: Why is the profit event missing in Meta?
faq.answer: Meta must receive a profit event before it appears in the selector. Check cost coverage and confirm the test order had marketing and analytics consent.

faq.question: Can I keep bidding on revenue?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the standard Purchase event with a revenue target instead of creating a profit conversion.

faq.question: Who changes the ad set conversion event?
faq.answer: You create the custom conversion in Meta Events Manager and select it in the ad set. The assistant guides you through those steps.
